facts.business: Brand Concepts Ltd is a brand-led lifestyle accessories company engaged in the design, development, manufacturing and retailing of travel gear, handbags, backpacks, luggage, small leather goods, apparels and related fashion accessories through a portfolio of licensed international brands and homegrown labels.

capacity_or_capex.item: Manufacturing facility in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh with integrated warehousing infrastructure and backward-integration initiatives
Investment property - commercial plot of land addition

key_risks: Revenue recognition complexity due to variable consideration including forecast of sales returns and discounts
Impairment risk on investments (recognized H 11.84 Lakhs impairment on associate investment)
facts.related_party_note: Investment in associate 7E Wellness India Private Limited (49% holding, 4,73,590 shares of H 10/- each)
